Container.Name: inferzero
Container.Overview: Local inference server for Intel Arc GPUs using Intel's Level Zero and OpenCL runtime. This template uses the reproducible image published from the Dockerfile in the catduck templates repository; it is not the locally built Uranium image. Standard inference requires a compatible Intel GPU driver in the Unraid host kernel. The optional experimental Unraid P2P kernel is not required; review the versioned installation and rollback guidance linked in the repository README before considering it. Set Model to an Inferzero catalog key or a GGUF path in the persistent Models folder. Models and any required mmproj vision projector must be accessible in the Hugging Face cache mapping. Cache persists compiled kernels and runtime state. Map the Intel GPU render node(s) selected on this host; render node numbers are host-specific. GPU count controls splitting one model across that many GPUs, not GPU discovery. Intel GPU inference only; NVIDIA is not an Inferzero backend. The Web UI and OpenAI-compatible API have no built-in authentication. Keep the web port on a trusted LAN or behind a secured reverse proxy; do not expose it directly to the internet. The container runs as root, so mapped files may be root-owned. Full setup, storage, multi-GPU and version-specific guidance: https://github.com/catduckgnaf/catduck-unraid-templates#inferzero

Config.Name: Web UI / API
Config.Description: Web UI and OpenAI-compatible API. No built-in authentication; restrict access to a trusted network.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Persistent model downloads from Hugging Face. Models may require several GB or more.

Config.Name: Inferzero cache
Config.Description: Persistent compiled GPU kernels and runtime state.

Config.Name: Intel GPU 1 render device
Config.Description: First Intel GPU render node. Select the matching /dev/dri/renderD* node on this Unraid host; node numbers can change after reboot or hardware changes.

Config.Name: Intel GPU 2 render device (optional)
Config.Description: Optional second Intel GPU render node for multi-GPU inference. Select the host's matching render node; set GPU count to 2 only when both devices are mapped and the model supports splitting.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Inferzero model catalog key (for example 4b) or a GGUF path accessible in the container.

Config.Name: GPU count
Config.Description: Number of Intel GPUs to split this model across. NVIDIA is not supported as an inference backend.
